current.text: He sits behind Donovan Clingan and Robert Williams at center in Portland. He may not even be the third-string center.
Donovan Clingan is projected to start at center for Portland.
He has almost no chance to be a regular rotation player. He should not get minutes unless injuries hit the centers ahead of him.
He averaged 12 points, 8 rebounds and 3.8 assists in Summer League.
Experts do not think he is ready to play in the NBA.

durable.text: He projects to get almost no steals, even for a center.

tags.name: out of rotation
tags.detail: Third or fourth center behind Clingan and Robert Williams
tags.new_meaning: Not expected to be in his team's regular rotation, so he has no fantasy value unless injuries open minutes.
